recommendation_rationale: Watch based on a deterministic evidence-only fallback because OPENAI_API_KEY was not set. The decision leans on YC/company-site evidence and treats HN as a weak freshness signal. Metadata: YC batch: Summer 2023; Industry: Fintech; Status: Active; Stage: Early; Team size: 10; Tags: Fintech, Compliance, Fraud Prevention, Regtech, AI
risks: Founder backgrounds and customer traction are not deeply verified from the available public evidence.
HN traction may be absent or noisy for B2B companies.
The product could be a thin AI interface unless workflow depth is confirmed.
If the company is acquired or inactive, it is outside the seed-stage sourcing target.

rationale_by_component.defensibility: Conservative unless workflow depth or integrations are visible.
rationale_by_component.market: Market score reflects B2B/SMB/workflow hints, not a full market-sizing exercise.

rationale_by_component.traction_freshness: Freshness comes from YC batch metadata and any HN stories found.
rationale_by_component.why_now: Higher where AI/agent/LLM language appears in evidence.

what_would_change_mind: Verified customer traction or revenue from the target buyer.
Founder-background evidence showing strong domain or technical fit.
Proof that the product executes an end-to-end workflow with integrations or proprietary data.
why_now: The why-now case is strongest where the evidence shows AI agents moving from advice into operational execution. Current freshness/traction signal: No relevant HN traction was found in the top filtered search results. [HN1]
why_we_care: It maps to the thesis if the product owns a repeated operating workflow rather than a thin assistant layer. The available evidence points to: AI agents for fintech risk and compliance operations [YC1]
